native_mechanisms: A grey wax trough where each mark's impression is pressed atop prior, still-warm impressions, so only the churned sum of collisions is ever held.
Seven differently-tuned insect swarms bite a dipped wire, each in its own count and rhythm, carried to a forward-only spinning slate wheel so no bite can be undone.
A brine basin that freezes the wire's bite-pattern into a unique six-flower frost lattice, sketched to tin as the surviving token.
core_technique: Seven parallel 64-bit lanes absorbing 56-byte stripes by add-then-rotate with distinct fixed per-lane rotation amounts (no multiply/xor in the absorb loop), then a six-node rotate-add tree fold and a length-salted moremur multiply-xor-shift finalizer.
